notes.title: Please buy my game!
notes.content:
Greetings, dear wealthy customer!

Steam pays me by the $100, though since Steam takes a cut, I only get the $100 when my game makes roughly $143 (30% Steam cut).

I've made $140 on my game around the time of writing this post, so it should only take three kind-hearted souls buying my game in order for me to get paid.

I need the money to buy my Asian friend a copy of GTA 5 for Christmas.

With that said, Merry Christmas!
